purpose: Isolate whether retrospective credit to a genuinely executed turn from a later real synthetic-task reward improves choice over the unmodified original Yggdrasil local immediate learner, without claiming navigation transfer

world.type: fully disclosed deterministic synthetic two-context finite-memory delay task; NO MiniGrid environment, no original source, no learning from K4U DEV
world.target: action0 when x<goal_x; action1 when x>goal_x, action2 is legal but nonrewarding; target criterion is an explicit known synthetic task rule, not an inferred MiniGrid causal law
world.selected_initial_action: one of 0/1/2, uniform FIT behavior policy
world.original_observed_reward: 0 at turn; 0 at first forward; 1 at terminal forward only if initial action matches context's target, otherwise 0
world.synthetic_train_schedule: 96 examples per each of 2 FIT initial x contexts and 3 initial legal actions, deterministically permuted with Random(20261024)
world.synthetic_test_schedule: 64 examples at each unseen x, randomized deterministic order Random(20261025)

methods: Original unchanged GridColony.observe direct synthetic rewards on all three genuinely executed actions. No retrospective credit added.

Credit intervention uses original GridColony cells but adds one selected-previous-action eligibility update at terminal using actual observed final reward discounted by frozen gamma**2. No reward is invented for unexecuted action; synthetic task data and supplemental credit are explicitly algorithmic, not environment reward.
Conventional tabular eligibility-credit policy keyed by signed relative goal x; count and fit actions and actual later terminal rewards from exactly the same FIT episodes.
Negative causal ablation: shuffled terminal rewards over FIT episodes with same multiset and same experiences, fixed RNG, test for degradation.

param.scoring: original GridColony.choose for both original and credit intervention; deterministic lowest-action tie

acceptance.source_integrity: original exact native Git blob and protocol SHA verified before any tests
acceptance.test_output_repro: two identical independent Python processes produce deterministic same result, digest excluding timers
acceptance.any_failure: scientific mechanism PROBE_NO_GO; no tuned parameters, second seed cherry-picking, original MiniGrid reruns or claim of native transfer

resource: whole-run CPU seconds, wall seconds, Python maximum RSS and policy serialized bytes; no FLOP/energy advantage claims; all training events matched although credit intervention has extra update cost
